sources.note: Nothing. Ethnographic handbook chapter; its LANGUAGES section (pp. 921-923) only classifies Quillacinga (Cochean/Kamsa family, Quillacinga subgroup, after Castellvi 1934) and states the language is extinct; no forms, no phonology, no prosody. Ortiz's companion chapter (pp. 961-968) lists modern communities in former Quillacinga territory with no language data. Quote above (p. 923, scanned diacritics normalised) is identity/classification context only, not a prosodic statement.
